\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{Madrid}
\setbeamertemplate{theorems}[ams style]

\title{AMS theorem conformance}
\date{}

\theoremstyle{remark}
\newtheorem{remark}[theorem]{Remark}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{AMS theorem heading}
  \begin{theorem}[Named result]
    The theorem body uses the plain theorem style.
  \end{theorem}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{AMS remark heading}
  \begin{remark}
    A remark has upright body text and an italic heading.
  \end{remark}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
